concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI mandates 'Confidence intervals for performance metrics (e.g., R², MAE) must also be provided', but no task in tasks.md computes or reports CIs for R² or MAE. T049/T050/T054 cover p-value, power, and per-fold metrics only. Add CI computation (e.g., fold-wise or bootstrap CIs for MAE/R²) to T049 or T050 and a corresponding field in output.json, or the constitution-mandated reporting silently disappears at execution time.

plan.md lists Partial Dependence Plots as a deliverable ('shap_analysis.py # TreeSHAP, permutation, PDP'; Risk: 'VIF analysis and Partial Dependence Plots'), but no task produces PDPs. Either add PDP output to T051 or note in the re-plan note that PDP is dropped as unrequested gold-plating (spec FR-006 does not require it) — currently the plan element is silently uncovered.
